title: Thai Beef Lettuce Wraps
description: A Chinese-inspired dish with marinated beef, crunchy lettuce, and nutty flavors.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together chili sauce, sesame oil, and peanut butter.
2. Add the sliced beef to the marinade and let it sit for at least 30 minutes.
3. Preheat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
4. Remove the beef from the marinade and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Add the beef back to the marinade and stir to coat.
6. Serve the beef in lettuce wraps with additional chili sauce, if desired.
